annotations.title: Check eligibility for ShyftOff remote work

description: Quick self-check against ShyftOff's published requirements for remote customer service agents: 18+, in the US, a modern computer, a USB headset, wired internet at 25 Mbps+, and a quiet private space. No experience required. Returns what's met, what's missing with how to fix it, next steps and David's referral sign-up link. Pass whatever the person has told you; unknown items are listed for them to confirm.

has_computer.description: Has a modern computer (many programs ask for Windows 11 with 8 GB RAM).

has_quiet_space.description: Has a quiet, private place to work.

has_usb_headset.description: Has a USB headset with a noise-cancelling microphone.

in_us.description: Whether they live in the United States.

internet_mbps.description: Internet speed in Mbps, if known.

name: check_eligibility
title: Check eligibility for ShyftOff remote work
